title: Jamaican Pork Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic curry dish made with tender pork and a blend of Jamaican spices.
instructions: 1. Heat the nourishing oil in a large pan over medium heat.
2. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
4. Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
5. Add the pork and cook until browned on all sides.
6. Add the allspice, thyme, salt, and black pepper.
7. Add the coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
8. Reduce heat to low and cook for 1.5 hours, or until the pork is tender.
9. Stir in the curry leaves and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
10. Serve the curry hot over rice or with naan bread.
